title: Tretet ein in den Grenzschutz Ost! Schütz die Heimat gegen Bolschewismus!
historicalContext: [NEEDS REVIEW] 1 print (poster) : lithograph, color ; 95 x 72 cm. | Poster shows a village in flames with a large claw-like hand formed out of smoke posed over the buildings. Text encourages people to volunteer for the Eastern Border Protection Corps in order to protect against Bolshevism.
explanation: [NEEDS REVIEW] This piece uses fear appeals to motivate action by highlighting dangers and threats.
